description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Sec. 194 of Inland Revenue Act, that the Regulations of Transitional Provisions
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under Section 194 of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, detailing transitional provisions for tax law implementation. It establishes legal frameworks for tax exemptions, deductions, and compliance requirements, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
